description: Pareto analysis, not just a Pareto chart. Drop in a category and a measure and get a correct Pareto instantly: bars ranked by contribution, cumulative percentage line, vital-few detection and an insight sentence - all computed in the visual, no DAX patterns to maintain. Correct by default. Deterministic ordering with tied values, stable sort in Power BI Desktop and the Service, automatic aggregation of duplicate categories, percentage and currency measures via your model format strings, and high-cardinality data loaded in full (up to 30,000 categories) with a configurable Others bar instead of scroll bars. Free features: Automatic cumulative % line, threshold line at any percent (default 80/20) Vital-few / trivial-many bar coloring, per-category colors and rules Top-N with Others grouping, bar values and cumulative % labels Vital-few insight sentence ("7 of 212 categories drive 80% of the total") 5 built-in themes, report theme colors, transparent background Cross-filtering, drill hierarchies, bookmarks, tooltips, high contrast, keyboard navigation, localization (EN, CS, DE, FR, ES) Renders up to 25 individual categories (plus Others) Premium features (per-user license via Microsoft AppSource): Unlimited categories ABC classification: A/B/C zones with custom cutoffs (80/95/100), zone shading, labels and tooltip classes Smart Insights+: headline callout (Top 7 of 212 = 80.3%)…
